title: windmannia horsfieldii
intro: Windmannia horsfieldii, commonly known as Windmannia, is a plant species within the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential to offer health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and stress. Bioactive constituents of Windmannia include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
